description: Real bug fixes from open-source Python projects not written by the Cerberus author, verified in the Docker sandbox. Each bug is pinned to its upstream fix commit; the reproduction test is the test that commit added. Wrong variants are hand-made from the same bug.

issue.title: get_real_name returns an intermediate component for names with more than two dotted parts
issue.body: For a fully-qualified identifier such as db.schema.tbl.col, Identifier.get_real_name() returns 'schema' instead of 'col'. get_name() is affected too. Two-part names like a.b are correct.

variants.note: the unmodified upstream commit, which appends its test to an existing test file
fixes the bug but also strips identifier quoting
the regressing patch plus edits to the three existing tests it breaks

issue.title: backoff_iter with factor=1.0 and no count raises ZeroDivisionError
issue.body: `backoff_iter` and `backoff` accept factor >= 1.0, but calling `backoff(1, 10, factor=1.0)` without a count crashes with ZeroDivisionError from math.log. A constant factor should either work (start == stop) or raise a clear ValueError.

variants.note: raises ValueError for every factor of 1.0, including start == stop

issue.title: last() raises ValueError when __reversed__ is None
issue.body: `mi.last(obj)` for an iterable whose class sets `__reversed__ = None` (the documented way to opt out of reversal) raises ValueError instead of returning the last item. `hasattr(iterable, '__reversed__')` is true, so `reversed()` is called and its TypeError is swallowed.

variants.note: the upstream test plus an import that does not exist
a test that already passes on the buggy code
